//: The VS Code extension host require()s an extension's entry point, so this subtree must emit CommonJS. Under module:Node16 tsc picks the emit format per file from the nearest package.json, so this marker makes the ordinary `npm run build` emit require() here while the rest of src/ stays ESM under the root "type": "module". Without it the VSIX shipped an entry starting `import * as vscode from 'vscode'`, which threw "Cannot use import statement outside a module" at activation and killed every command.
